card.name: Hyphen after the word Drug
card.fires_on: The hyphen right after "Drug" in section headings such as Drug-Induced or Drug-Drug. It also fires weakly on a broken hyphen-like character before "agonist".

modes.label: Drug- headings
modes.description: Hyphen following "Drug" in headings like Drug-Induced or Drug-Drug Interactions.

modes.label: Garbled hyphen
modes.description: A damaged hyphen-like character inside a compound such as beta 2 agonist.
